claims: C1 the overall ranking of answer outcomes, best to worst, is: confident right answer, hedged right answer, no answer, hedged wrong answer, confident wrong answer

concepts.name: confident_right_answer
concepts.gloss: an answer outcome that is correct and given with confidence

concepts.name: hedged_right_answer
concepts.gloss: an answer outcome that is correct but expressed with hedging

concepts.name: no_answer
concepts.gloss: an answer outcome in which no answer is given

concepts.name: hedged_wrong_answer
concepts.gloss: an answer outcome that is wrong and expressed with hedging

concepts.name: confident_wrong_answer
concepts.gloss: an answer outcome that is wrong and given with confidence

concepts.name: outcome_ranking
concepts.gloss: outcome O1 is ranked better than outcome O2 in the overall ranking of answer outcomes
